class.name: Ranger

default: (a) two {@item shortsword|phb|shortswords} or (b) two {@filter simple melee weapons|items|source=phb|category=basic|type=simple weapon;melee weapon=sand}
(a) a {@item dungeoneer's pack|phb} or (b) an {@item explorer's pack|phb}
A {@item longbow|phb} and a {@item quiver|phb} of {@item arrows (20)|phb|20 arrows}

classFeatures: Favored Enemy and Natural Explorer improvements|Ranger||6

entries: {@i 選擇 A 或 B：}（A）{@item Studded Leather Armor|XPHB|鑲釘皮甲}、{@item Scimitar|XPHB|彎刀}、{@item Shortsword|XPHB|短劍}、{@item Longbow|XPHB|長弓}、{@item Arrows (20)|XPHB|20 支箭}、{@item Quiver|XPHB|箭袋}、{@item Druidic Focus|XPHB|德魯伊法器}（{@item sprig of mistletoe|XPHB|槲寄生枝}）、{@item Explorer's Pack|XPHB|探索者套裝}，以及 7 GP；或（B）150 GP

classFeature.name: Deft Explorer
entries: {@i 1st-level ranger {@variantrule optional class features|tce|optional feature}, which replaces the Natural Explorer feature}

You are an unsurpassed explorer and survivor, both in the wilderness and in dealing with others on your travels. You gain the Canny benefit below, and you gain an additional benefit below when you reach 6th level and 10th level in this class.

entries.name: Canny
entries: Choose one of your skill proficiencies. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses the chosen skill.
You can also speak, read, and write two additional languages of your choice.

classFeature.name: Favored Enemy
entries: 從1級開始，你在對一個特定類型的敵人的研究、追跡、狩獵、和甚至交談上已相當具備充足的經驗。

選擇一個宿敵類型：{@filter 異怪|bestiary|type=aberration}、{@filter 野獸|bestiary|type=beast}、{@filter 天界生物|bestiary|type=celestial}、{@filter 構裝體|bestiary|type=construct}、{@filter 龍|bestiary|type=dragon}、{@filter 元素|bestiary|type=elemental}、{@filter 精類|bestiary|type=fey}、{@filter 邪魔|bestiary|type=fiend}、{@filter 巨人|bestiary|type=giant}、{@filter 怪獸|bestiary|type=monstrosity}、{@filter 泥怪|bestiary|type=ooze}、{@filter 植物|bestiary|type=plant}、或{@filter 不死生物|bestiary|type=undead}。或者，你可以選擇二個{@filter 類人生物|bestiary|type=humanoid}種族（像是{@creature Gnoll|mm|豺狼人}和{@creature Orc|mm|獸人}）做為宿敵。
你在用於追蹤你宿敵的睿知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定、以及用以回憶關於它們情報的智力檢定中具有優勢。
當你獲得此能力時，若你的宿敵擁有至少一種語言，你也選擇學會一種被它們所使用的語言。
你在6級和14級時選擇一種額外的宿敵以及一種關聯語言。隨著你提升等級，你的選擇必須反映你在你冒險中所遭遇過的怪物類型。

classFeature.name: Favored Foe
entries: {@i 1st-level ranger {@variantrule optional class features|tce|optional feature}, which replaces the Favored Enemy feature and works with the Foe Slayer feature}

When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can call on your mystical bond with nature to mark the target as your favored enemy for 1 minute or until you lose your {@status concentration} (as if you were {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell).
The first time on each of your turns that you hit the favored enemy and deal damage to it, including when you mark it, you can increase that damage by {@damage 1d4}.
You can use this feature to mark a favored enemy a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
This feature's extra damage increases when you reach certain levels in this class: to {@damage 1d6} at 6th level and to {@damage 1d8} at 14th level.

classFeature.name: Natural Explorer
entries: 你特別熟悉於一種自然環境，且熟稔在這類區域中旅行和生存的方式。選擇一種偏好環境：極地、海岸、沙漠、森林、草地、高山、沼澤、或幽暗地域。當你進行一次關聯於你偏好環境的智力或睿知檢定時，若你使用一個你所熟練的技能，則你的熟練加值變為二倍。
當在你的偏好環境中旅行長達1個小時或更久，你將獲得下列好處：

items: 困難地形不會減慢你們團隊的旅行速度。
除非是因為魔法的緣故，否則你們團隊不會迷路。
即使你在旅行途中正從事於其他行動（像是覓食、導航、或追跡），你仍保持對危險的警戒。
若你正獨自旅行，你能夠以正常步調隱匿移動。
當你覓食時，你能找到二倍你原本所能找到的食物。
當你追跡其他生物時，你也能得知它們確切的數量、它們的體型、以及它們在多久之前經過這片區域。

entries: 你在6級和10級時選擇一種額外的偏好環境。

classFeature.name: Fighting Style
entries: 在2級時，你採用一種特殊的戰鬥風格以做為你的專業。從下列選項中選擇一種。你不能獲得相同的戰鬥風格選項超過一次，即使你有機會再選擇它也一樣。

classFeature.name: Spellcasting
entries: 在你升至2級時，你學會如同德魯伊的方式使用大自然的精粹以施放法術。請參閱{@book 第十章|PHB|10}以了解關於施法的規則，以及第十一章以查閱{@filter 遊俠法術列表|spells|class=ranger}。

entries.name: Spell Slots
entries: 遊俠表中顯示了你有多少個法術位可以用來施放你一環或更高環的{@filter 遊俠法術|spells|class=ranger}。要施放其中一個法術，你必須消耗一個與該法術環階相同或更高的法術位。你在完成一次長休後恢復所有你花費掉的法術位。
舉例來說，如果你知曉一個1環的{@spell Animal Friendship||化獸為友}法術，且你擁有一個1環和一個2環的法術位，則你可以使用其中任意一個法術位來施放{@spell Animal Friendship||化獸為友}。

entries.name: Spells Known of 1st Level and Higher
entries: 你知曉二個從遊俠法術列表中自選的1環法術。
遊俠表中的已知法術欄位顯示你將在何時學習到更多自選的遊俠法術。每個這些法術的環階都必須符合你所擁有法術位的環階。舉例來說，當你在此職業升至5級時，你可以學習一個新的1環或2環法術。
此外，當你提升這個職業的等級時，你可以從遊俠的法術列表中挑選一個法術來取代一個你目前已知的法術，而它的環階也必須符合你所擁有法術位的環階。
entries.name_zh: 一環或更高環的已知法術
entries._zhOf: Spells Known of 1st Level and Higher

entries.name: Spellcasting Ability
entries: 由於你的魔法是源自你與大自然的協調，睿知是你施展遊俠法術的施法屬性。每當法術提及你的施法屬性時，你將使用你的睿知。此外，當決定你遊俠法術的豁免DC、以及使用遊俠法術進行攻擊檢定時，你使用你的睿知調整值。

classFeature.name: Spellcasting Focus
entries: {@i 2nd-level ranger {@variantrule optional class features|tce|optional feature}}

You can use a {@item druidic focus|phb} as a spellcasting focus for your ranger spells. A druidic focus might be a sprig of mistletoe or holly, a wand or rod made of yew or another special wood, a staff drawn whole from a living tree, or an object incorporating feathers, fur, bones, and teeth from sacred animals.

classFeature.name: Primal Awareness
entries: {@i 3rd-level ranger {@variantrule optional class features|tce|optional feature}, which replaces the Primeval Awareness feature}

You can focus your awareness through the interconnections of nature: you learn additional spells when you reach certain levels in this class if you don't already know them, as shown in the Primal Awareness Spells table. These spells don't count against the number of ranger spells you know.
You can cast each of these spells once without expending a spell slot. Once you cast a spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

classFeature.name: Primeval Awareness
entries: 從3級開始，你可以使用你的動作並消耗一個遊俠法術位以集中你的意識於你周遭的區域。在為你所消耗法術位的每環階1分鐘內，你可以感知下列類型的生物是否存在於距離你1哩內的區域：異怪、天界生物、龍、元素、精類、邪魔、和不死生物。此能力無法揭露出該生物的位置和數量。

classFeature.name: Ranger Archetype
entries: 在3級時，你從可選範型列表中選擇一種你致力於達成的範型。你的選擇將在3級、7級、11級、和15級時賦予你新的能力。

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: 當你在此職業升至4級時，你可以增加一項自選屬性值2點，或著你可以增加二項自選屬性值各1點。如同平常一樣，你不能透過這個能力將一個屬性值提升至超過20。
如果你的DM允許使用專長的話，你也可以改為獲得一個{@5etools 專長|feats.html}。

classFeature.name: Martial Versatility
entries: {@i 4th-level ranger {@variantrule optional class features|tce|optional feature}}

Whenever you reach a level in this class that grants the Ability Score Improvement feature, you can replace a fighting style you know with another fighting style available to rangers. This replacement represents a shift of focus in your martial practice.

classFeature.name: Extra Attack
entries: 從5級開始，每當你在你的回合採取{@action Attack||攻擊}動作，你可以攻擊二次，而非一次。

classFeature.name: Deft Explorer Improvement
entries: You gain an additional benefit when you reach 6th level in this class.

entries.name: Roving
entries: Your walking speed increases by 5, and you gain a climbing speed and a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

classFeature.name: Favored Enemy and Natural Explorer improvements
entries: 在6級時，你獲得一種額外的偏好環境。
在6級時，你選擇一種額外的宿敵以及一種關聯語言。你的選擇必須反映你在你冒險中所遭遇過的怪物類型。
classFeature.name_zh: 宿敵和自然探索者強化
classFeature._zhOf: Favored Enemy and Natural Explorer improvements

classFeature.name: Ranger Archetype feature
entries: 在7級時，你獲得一個由你遊俠範型所賦予的能力。

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: 當你在此職業升至8級時，你可以增加一項自選屬性值2點，或著你可以增加二項自選屬性值各1點。如同平常一樣，你不能透過這個能力將一個屬性值提升至超過20。
如果你的DM允許使用專長的話，你也可以改為獲得一個{@5etools 專長|feats.html}。

classFeature.name: Land's Stride
entries: 從8級開始，移動穿過非魔法的困難地形並不會花費你額外的移動速度。你也可以穿越非魔法植物而不會被它們減緩速度，若它們是荊棘、棘刺、或其他類似危險，你也不會被它們的傷害。
此外，在對抗由魔法創造或控制的植物所造成的阻礙移動效果時（像是{@spell Entangle||糾纏術}法術創造出的植物），你所進行的豁免檢定具有優勢。

classFeature.name: Deft Explorer Improvement
entries: You gain an additional benefit when you reach 10th level in this class.

entries.name: Tireless
entries: As an action, you can give yourself a number of temporary hit points equal to {@dice 1d8} + your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1 temporary hit point). You can use this action a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
In addition, whenever you finish a short rest, your {@condition exhaustion} level, if any, is decreased by 1.

classFeature.name: Hide in Plain Sight
entries: 從10級開始，你可以花費1分鐘的時間為自己創造一個偽裝。你必須要能取用新鮮的泥巴、土壤、植物、煙灰、和其他自然產出的材料以創造你的偽裝。
一旦你透過這個方式偽裝，你可以透過將自己貼合於一個高度和寬度至少與你一樣大的固體表面上，例如樹木或牆壁，以嘗試進行躲藏。只要你待於該處且不移動或採取動作，你就在敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定中獲得+10的加值。一旦你移動或採取動作或反應，你就必須再次偽裝自己以獲得這個好處。

classFeature.name: Natural Explorer improvement
entries: 在10級時，你獲得一種額外的偏好環境。

classFeature.name: Nature's Veil
entries: {@i 10th-level ranger {@variantrule optional class features|tce|optional feature}, which replaces the Hide in Plain Sight feature}

You draw on the powers of nature to hide yourself from view briefly. As a bonus action, you can magically become {@condition invisible}, along with any equipment you are wearing or carrying, until the start of your next turn.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

classFeature.name: Ranger Archetype feature
entries: 在11級時，你獲得一個由你遊俠範型所賦予的能力。

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: 當你在此職業升至12級時，你可以增加一項自選屬性值2點，或著你可以增加二項自選屬性值各1點。如同平常一樣，你不能透過這個能力將一個屬性值提升至超過20。
如果你的DM允許使用專長的話，你也可以改為獲得一個{@5etools 專長|feats.html}。

classFeature.name: Favored Enemy improvement
entries: 在14級時，你選擇一種額外的宿敵以及一種關聯語言。你的選擇必須反映你在你冒險中所遭遇過的怪物類型。

classFeature.name: Vanish
entries: 從14級開始，你可以在你的回合以一個附贈動作採取{@action Hide||躲藏}動作。同時，你不會被非魔法的手段追蹤，除非你選擇留下蹤跡。

classFeature.name: Ranger Archetype feature
entries: 在15級時，你獲得一個由你遊俠範型所賦予的能力。

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: 當你在此職業升至16級時，你可以增加一項自選屬性值2點，或著你可以增加二項自選屬性值各1點。如同平常一樣，你不能透過這個能力將一個屬性值提升至超過20。
如果你的DM允許使用專長的話，你也可以改為獲得一個{@5etools 專長|feats.html}。

classFeature.name: Feral Senses
entries: 在18級時，你獲得超自然的感官以幫助你對抗看不見的生物。當你攻擊一個你看不見的生物時，你並不會因為無法看見它而在你對它進行的攻擊檢定中承受劣勢。同時，只要該生物沒有躲藏於你，且你不處於{@condition Blinded||目盲}或{@condition Deafened||耳聾}狀態，則你也能察覺到任何距離你30呎內{@condition Invisible||隱形}生物的位置。

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: 當你在此職業升至19級時，你可以增加一項自選屬性值2點，或著你可以增加二項自選屬性值各1點。如同平常一樣，你不能透過這個能力將一個屬性值提升至超過20。
如果你的DM允許使用專長的話，你也可以改為獲得一個{@5etools 專長|feats.html}。

classFeature.name: Foe Slayer
entries: 在20級時，你成為了一名針對你敵人的無雙獵手。在你的每個回合一次，你可以將你的睿知調整值加到你對你其中一個宿敵所進行的攻擊檢定或傷害骰中。你可以選擇在擲骰之前或之後使用此能力，但是必須在任何擲骰效果適用之前使用。

classFeature.name: Favored Enemy
entries: 你總是準備著{@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB|獵人印記}法術。你可以不消耗法術欄位施展它兩次，並在完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時恢復此能力所有已消耗的使用次數。
當你達到特定遊俠等級時，你能不使用法術欄位施展此法術的次數會增加，如遊俠能力表中「宿敵」一欄所示。

classFeature.name: Spellcasting
entries: 你已學會引導自然的魔法精髓來施展法術。施法規則請參閱{@book 第 7 章|XPHB|7}。以下說明你如何將這些規則運用在遊俠法術上，遊俠法術列於本職業說明後面的{@filter 遊俠法術列表|spells|class=Ranger}中。

entries.name: Spell Slots
entries: 遊俠能力表顯示你有多少法術欄位可用來施展 1 環以上的法術。你在完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時恢復所有已消耗的法術欄位。

entries.name: Prepared Spells of Level 1+
entries: 你準備一份能透過此能力施展的 1 環以上法術清單。一開始，選擇兩個{@filter 1 環遊俠法術|spells|class=Ranger|level=1}。推薦選擇{@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB|治療傷口}與{@spell Ensnaring Strike|XPHB|誘捕打擊}。
清單上的法術數量隨你的遊俠等級增加，如遊俠能力表中「準備法術」一欄所示。每當該數字增加，選擇更多遊俠法術，直到清單上的法術數量與遊俠能力表中的數字相符。所選法術的環階必須是你擁有法術欄位的環階。例如，若你是 5 級遊俠，你的準備法術清單可以包含六個 1 環或 2 環遊俠法術的任意組合。
若另一項遊俠能力讓你總是準備某些法術，這些法術不計入你能以此能力準備的法術數量，但除此之外這些法術對你而言都算作遊俠法術。

entries.name: Changing Your Prepared Spells
entries: 每當你完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}，你可以將清單上的一個法術替換為另一個你擁有法術欄位可施展的遊俠法術。

entries.name: Spellcasting Ability
entries: 睿知是你遊俠法術的施法屬性。

entries.name: Spellcasting Focus
entries: 你可以使用{@item Druidic Focus|XPHB|德魯伊法器}作為你遊俠法術的{@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB|施法法器}。

classFeature.name: Weapon Mastery
entries: 你的武器訓練讓你能使用你所選擇、且你已熟練的兩種{@filter 武器|items|type=simple weapon;martial weapon}的{@variantrule weapon mastery properties|XPHB|精通屬性}，例如{@item Longbow|XPHB|長弓}與{@item Shortsword|XPHB|短劍}。
每當你完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}，你可以更換你所選擇的武器種類。例如，你可以改為使用{@item Scimitar|XPHB|彎刀}與{@item Longsword|XPHB|長劍}的{@variantrule weapon mastery properties|XPHB|精通屬性}。

classFeature.name: Deft Explorer
entries: 憑藉你的旅行經歷，你獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Expertise
entries: 從你已熟練但尚未擁有{@variantrule Expertise|XPHB|專精}的技能中選擇一項。你在該技能上獲得{@variantrule Expertise|XPHB|專精}。

entries.name: Languages
entries: 你從{@book 第 2 章|XPHB|2|Choose Languages}的語言表中選擇兩種語言並習得。

classFeature.name: Fighting Style
entries: 你獲得一個由你選擇的{@filter 戰鬥風格專長|feats|category=FS}。你也可以不選擇這些專長，改為選擇下方的選項。

classFeature.name: Ranger Subclass
entries: 你獲得一個你所選擇的遊俠子職業。子職業是一種專精方向，會在特定遊俠等級賦予你能力。在你往後的生涯中，你會獲得子職業中所有等級不高於你遊俠等級的能力。

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: 你獲得{@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB|屬性值提升}專長，或其他一個你符合條件且由你選擇的{@5etools 專長|feats.html}。你會在遊俠 8、12 與 16 級時再次獲得此能力。

classFeature.name: Extra Attack
entries: 每當你在你的回合採取{@action Attack|XPHB|攻擊}動作時，你可以攻擊兩次而非一次。

classFeature.name: Roving
entries: 當你沒有穿著重甲時，你的{@variantrule Speed|XPHB|速度}增加 10 呎。你也擁有等同於你{@variantrule Speed|XPHB|速度}的{@variantrule Climb Speed|XPHB|攀爬速度}與{@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB|游泳速度}。

classFeature.name: Subclass Feature
entries: 你從你的遊俠子職業獲得一項能力。

classFeature.name: Expertise
entries: 從你已熟練但尚未擁有{@variantrule Expertise|XPHB|專精}的技能中選擇兩項。你在這些技能上獲得{@variantrule Expertise|XPHB|專精}。

classFeature.name: Tireless
entries: 原初之力如今在旅途中為你補充能量，賦予你以下益處。

entries.name: Temporary Hit Points
entries: 你可以用一個{@action Magic|XPHB|魔法}動作，給予自己等同 {@dice 1d8} 加上你睿知調整值（最少 1）的{@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB|臨時生命值}。你可以採取此動作的次數等同於你的睿知調整值（最少一次），並在完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時恢復所有已消耗的使用次數。

entries.name: Decrease Exhaustion
entries: 每當你完成一次{@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|短休}，若你有{@condition Exhaustion|XPHB|力竭}等級，該等級減少 1。

classFeature.name: Relentless Hunter
entries: 受到傷害不會打斷你對獵人印記的{@status Concentration|XPHB|專注}。

classFeature.name: Nature's Veil
entries: 你呼喚自然之靈以魔法隱藏自己。你可以用一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}使自己陷入{@condition Invisible|XPHB|隱形}狀態，直到你的下個回合結束為止。
你可以使用此能力的次數等同於你的睿知調整值（最少一次），並在完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時恢復所有已消耗的使用次數。

classFeature.name: Precise Hunter
entries: 你對當前被你的獵人印記標記的生物進行的攻擊檢定具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。

classFeature.name: Feral Senses
entries: 你與自然之力的連結，賦予你範圍 30 呎的{@sense Blindsight|XPHB|盲視}。

classFeature.name: Epic Boon
entries: 你獲得一個{@filter 史詩恩賜專長|feats|category=EB}，或其他一個你符合條件且由你選擇的{@5etools 專長|feats.html}。推薦選擇{@feat Boon of Dimensional Travel|XPHB|次元旅行之恩賜}。

classFeature.name: Foe Slayer
entries: 你獵人印記的傷害骰改為 {@damage d10}，而非 {@damage d6}。

subclassFeature.name: Drakewarden
entries: Your connection to the natural world takes the form of a draconic spirit, which can manifest in physical form as a drake. As your powers grow, your drake grows as well, blossoming from a small four-legged companion to a majestic winged creature large and strong enough for you to ride. Along the way, you gain an increasing share of the awe-inspiring power of dragons.
Consider the source of the draconic spirit you have bonded with. The Drakewarden Origin table offers examples.

entries.caption: Drakewarden Origin
rows: You studied a dragon's scale or claw, or a trinket from a dragon's hoard, creating your bond through that token's lingering draconic magic.
A secret order of rangers who collect and guard draconic lore taught you their ways.
A dragon gave you a geode or gemstone to care for. To your surprise, the drake hatched from that stone.
You ingested a few drops of dragon blood, forever infusing your nature magic with draconic power.
An ancient Draconic inscription on a standing stone empowered you when you read it aloud.
You had a vivid dream of a mysterious figure accompanied by seven yellow canaries, who warned you of impending doom. When you awoke, your drake was there, watching you.

subclassFeature.name: Draconic Gift
entries: {@i 3rd-level Drakewarden feature}
The bond you share with your drake creates a connection to dragonkind, granting you understanding and empowering your presence. You gain the following benefits:

items.name: Thaumaturgy
items.entry: You learn the {@spell thaumaturgy} cantrip, which is a ranger spell for you.

items.name: Tongue of Dragons
items.entry: You learn to speak, read, and write Draconic or one other language of your choice.

subclassFeature.name: Drake Companion
entries: {@i 3rd-level Drakewarden feature}
As an action, you can magically summon the drake that is bound to you. It appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within 30 feet of you.

The drake is friendly to you and your companions, and it obeys your commands. See its game statistics in the accompanying {@creature Drake Companion|FTD} stat block, which uses your proficiency bonus (PB) in several places. Whenever you summon the drake, choose a damage type listed in its Draconic Essence trait. You can determine the cosmetic characteristics of the drake, such as its color, its scale texture, or any visible effect of its Draconic Essence; your choice has no effect on its game statistics.

In combat, the drake shares your initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It can move and use its reaction on its own, but the only action it takes on its turn is the {@action Dodge} action, unless you take a bonus action on your turn to command it to take another action. That action can be one in its stat block or some other action. If you are {@condition incapacitated}, the drake can take any action of its choice, not just {@action Dodge}.

The drake remains until it is reduced to 0 hit points, until you use this feature to summon the drake again, or until you die. Anything the drake was wearing or carrying is left behind when the drake vanishes.
Once you summon the drake, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest, unless you expend a spell slot of 1st level or higher to summon it.

subclassFeature.name: Bond of Fang and Scale
entries: {@i 7th-level Drakewarden feature}

The bond you share with your drake intensifies, protecting you and stoking the drake's fury. When you summon your drake, it grows wings on its back and gains a flying speed equal to its walking speed.
In addition, while your drake is summoned, you and the drake gain the following benefits:

items.name: Drake Mount
entries: The drake grows to Medium size. Reflecting your special bond, you can use the drake as a mount if your size is Medium or smaller. While you are riding your drake, it can't use the flying speed of this feature.

items.name: Magic Fang
entries: The drake's Bite attack deals an extra {@damage 1d6} damage of the type chosen for the drake's Draconic Essence.

items.name: Resistance
entries: You gain resistance to the damage type chosen for the drake's Draconic Essence.

subclassFeature.name: Drake's Breath
entries: {@i 11th-level Drakewarden feature}

As an action, you can exhale a 30-foot cone of damaging breath or cause your drake to exhale it. Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage (your choice doesn't have to match your drake's Draconic Essence). Each creature in the cone must make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking {@damage 8d6} damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
This damage increases to {@damage 10d6} when you reach 15th level in this class.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest, unless you expend a spell slot of 3rd level or higher to use it again.

subclassFeature.name: Perfected Bond
entries: {@i 15th-level Drakewarden feature}
Your bond to your drake reaches the pinnacle of its power. While your drake is summoned, you and the drake gain the following benefits:

items.name: Empowered Bite
entries: The drake's Bite attack deals an extra {@damage 1d6} damage of the type chosen for its Draconic Essence (for a total of {@damage 2d6} extra damage).

items.name: Large Drake
entries: The drake grows to Large size. When you ride your drake, it is no longer prohibited from using the flying speed of Bond of Fang and Scale.

items.name: Reflexive Resistance
entries: When either you or the drake takes damage while you're within 30 feet of each other, you can use your reaction to give yourself or the drake resistance to that instance of damage. You can use this reaction a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Beast Master
entries: 獸王範型體現了文明種族和自然野獸之間的情誼。團結一致，野獸和游俠將共同對抗威脅著文明和自然世界的可怕敵人。仿效獸王範型意味著將自己奉獻給這個理念，與動物做為同伴和朋友一同奮鬥。

subclassFeature.name: Primal Companion
entries: {@i 3rd-level Beast Master variant feature, which replaces the Ranger's Companion feature}

You magically summon a primal beast, which draws strength from your bond with nature. The beast is friendly to you and your companions and obeys your commands. Choose its stat block—{@creature Beast of the Land|TCE}, {@creature Beast of the Sea|TCE}, or {@creature Beast of the Sky|TCE}—which uses your proficiency bonus (PB) in several places. You also determine the kind of animal the beast is, choosing a kind appropriate for the stat block. Whatever kind you choose, the beast bears primal markings, indicating its mystical origin.

In combat, the beast acts during your turn. It can move and use its reaction on its own, but the only action it takes is the {@action Dodge} action, unless you take a bonus action on your turn to command it to take another action. That action can be one in its stat block or some other action. You can also sacrifice one of your attacks when you take the {@action Attack} action to command the beast to take the {@action Attack} action. If you are {@condition incapacitated}, the beast can take any action of its choice, not just {@action Dodge}.

If the beast has died within the last hour, you can use your action to touch it and expend a spell slot of 1st level or higher. The beast returns to life after 1 minute with all its hit points restored.

When you finish a long rest, you can summon a different primal beast. The new beast appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you, and you choose its stat block and appearance. If you already have a beast from this feature, it vanishes when the new beast appears. The beast also vanishes if you die.

subclassFeature.name: Ranger's Companion
entries: 在3級時，你獲得一個動物夥伴，牠將陪伴你一起冒險，並受過訓練以與你一起戰鬥。選擇一個{@filter 體型不超過中型，且挑戰等級為1/4或更低的野獸|bestiary|challenge rating=0;1/8;1/4|type=beast|size=f;d;t;s;m|miscellaneous=!swarm}。將你的熟練加值加入該野獸的AC、攻擊檢定、傷害骰，以及任何牠所熟練的豁免檢定和技能中。牠的生命值最大值等同於牠正常的生命值最大值或你遊俠等級的四倍，兩者取高。

該野獸將盡其所能的服從你的命令。牠會在你的先攻順序採取牠的行動。在你的回合，你可以口頭命令該野獸移動到某處（你不需要花費動作）。你也可以使用你的動作以口頭命令牠採取{@action Attack||攻擊}、{@action Dash||疾走}、{@action Disengage||撤離}、{@action Dodge||閃避}、或{@action Help||協助}動作。如果你沒有命令，牠將採取{@action Dodge||閃避}動作。一旦你獲得額外攻擊能力，則當你命令該野獸採取{@action Attack||攻擊}動作時，你可以自己進行一次武器攻擊。
若你處於{@condition Incapacitated||無力}狀態或不在現場，你的動物夥伴將會自主行動，專注於保護你或牠自己。牠使用牠的反應時不需要你的命令，例如進行一次藉機攻擊。
While traveling through your favored terrain with only the beast, you can move stealthily at a normal pace.
若該野獸死亡，你可以藉由花費8小時的時間以用魔法與另一個對你不具有敵意的野獸建立連結以再次獲得動物夥伴。該野獸可以是與之前那隻相同或不同類型的野獸。

subclassFeature.name: Exceptional Training
entries: 從7級開始，在你的任何回合，只要你的動物夥伴沒有攻擊，你就可以使用一個附贈動作以命令該野獸在它的回合採取{@action Dash||疾走}、{@action Disengage||撤離}、或{@action Help||協助}動作。此外，該野獸的攻擊現在起將在克服對非魔法攻擊和傷害的抗性和免疫能力時被視作魔法攻擊。

subclassFeature.name: Bestial Fury
entries: 從11級開始，當你命令你的動物夥伴採取{@action Attack||攻擊}動作時，該野獸可以進行二次攻擊，或採取牠擁有的多重攻擊動作。

subclassFeature.name: Share Spells
entries: 從15級開始，當你施放以你自己為目標的法術時，若你的動物夥伴距離你30呎內，你也可以讓它受到該法術的影響。

subclassFeature.name: Hunter
entries: 仿效獵人範型意味著接受你做為文明和荒野恐懼間壁壘的身分。隨著你行走在獵人的道途上，你學會對抗迎面而來威脅的專業技巧，從狂暴的食人魔、成群的獸人、到巨人和恐怖的龍族們。

subclassFeature.name: Horde Breaker
entries: 在你的每個回合一次，當你進行一次武器攻擊時，你可以使用相同的武器對一個距離原本目標5呎內，且處於你武器射程內的另一個生物進行另一次攻擊。

subclassFeature.name: Hunter's Prey
entries: 在3級時，你獲得下列其中一個你所選擇的能力：巨怪獵者、巨人殺手、或滅族者。

subclassFeature.name: Colossus Slayer
entries: 你的執著可以毀滅最強大的敵人。當你以一次武器攻擊命中一個生物，若它的生命值低於最大值，則該生物將受到額外的{@dice 1d8}傷害。你每回合只能造成一次這個額外傷害。

subclassFeature.name: Giant Killer
entries: 當一個距離你5呎內，體型為大型或更大的生物對你進行的一次攻擊命中或失手時，只要你可以看見該生物，你就可以使用你的反應以立刻在它的攻擊之後對它進行攻擊。

subclassFeature.name: Defensive Tactics
entries: 在7級時，你獲得下列其中一個你所選擇的能力：逃離眾敵、防禦多重攻擊、或鋼鐵意志。

subclassFeature.name: Escape the Horde
entries: 所有對你進行的藉機攻擊將具有劣勢。

subclassFeature.name: Multiattack Defense
entries: 當一個生物以一次攻擊命中你時，你的AC將對該生物在該回合中所進行的所有後續攻擊獲得+4的加值。

subclassFeature.name: Steel Will
entries: 你在對抗{@condition Frightened||恐懼}的豁免檢定中具有優勢。

subclassFeature.name: Multiattack
entries: 在11級時，你獲得下列其中一個你所選擇的能力：箭雨、或劍刃風暴。

subclassFeature.name: Volley
entries: 你可以使用你的動作以進行一次遠程攻擊，並以處於你武器射程內你所能看見一點的周圍10呎範圍內的任意數量個生物做為目標。你必須有足夠的彈藥以攻擊每個目標，且你為每個目標進行各自的攻擊檢定。

subclassFeature.name: Whirlwind Attack
entries: 你可以使用你的動作以進行一次近戰攻擊，並以距離你5呎內的任意數量個生物做為目標，為每個目標進行各自的攻擊檢定。

subclassFeature.name: Evasion
entries: 你可以靈活地躲開某些範圍效果，像是紅龍的火焰吐息、或{@spell Lightning Bolt||閃電束}法術。當你成為一個允許你進行敏捷豁免以僅承受一半傷害的效果的目標時，你改為在豁免成功時不受任何傷害，且在豁免失敗時僅承受一半傷害。

subclassFeature.name: Stand Against the Tide
entries: 當一個敵對生物對你進行的一次近戰攻擊失手，你可以使用你的反應以強迫該生物對你所選擇的另一個生物（除了它自己以外）重複進行一次該攻擊。

subclassFeature.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
entries: 在15級時，你獲得下列其中一個你所選擇的能力：反射閃避、逆潮而立、或直覺閃避。

subclassFeature.name: Uncanny Dodge
entries: 當一個你所能看見的攻擊者使用一次攻擊命中你，你可以使用你的反應以減半該次攻擊對你的傷害。

subclassFeature.name: Fey Wanderer
entries: A fey mystique surrounds you, thanks to the boon of an archfey, the shining fruit you ate from a talking tree, the magic spring you swam in, or some other auspicious event. However you acquired your fey magic, you are now a Fey Wanderer, a ranger who represents both the mortal and the fey realms. As you wander the multiverse, your joyful laughter brightens the hearts of the downtrodden, and your martial prowess strikes terror in your foes, for great is the mirth of the fey and dreadful is their fury.

subclassFeature.name: Dreadful Strikes
entries: {@i 3rd-level Fey Wanderer feature}

You can augment your weapon strikes with mind-scarring magic, drawn from the gloomy hollows of the Feywild. When you hit a creature with a weapon, you can deal an extra {@damage 1d4} psychic damage to the target, which can take this extra damage only once per turn.
The extra damage increases to {@damage 1d6} when you reach 11th level in this class.

subclassFeature.name: Fey Wanderer Magic
entries: {@i 3rd-level Fey Wanderer feature}

You learn an additional spell when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Fey Wanderer Spells table. Each spell counts as a ranger spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of ranger spells you know.
You also possess a preternatural blessing from a fey ally or a place of fey power. Choose your blessing from the Feywild Gifts table or determine it randomly.

entries.caption: Feywild Gifts
rows: Illusory butterflies flutter around you while you take a short or long rest.
Fresh, seasonal flowers sprout from your hair each dawn.
You faintly smell of cinnamon, lavender, nutmeg, or another comforting herb or spice.
Your shadow dances while no one is looking directly at it.
Horns or antlers sprout from your head.
Your skin and hair change color to match the season at each dawn.

subclassFeature.name: Otherworldly Glamour
entries: {@i 3rd-level Fey Wanderer feature}
Your fey qualities give you a supernatural charm. As a result, whenever you make a Charisma check, you gain a bonus to the check equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1).
In addition, you gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Deception}, {@skill Performance}, or {@skill Persuasion}.

subclassFeature.name: Beguiling Twist
entries: {@i 7th-level Fey Wanderer feature}
The magic of the Feywild guards your mind. You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

In addition, whenever you or a creature you can see within 120 feet of you succeeds on a saving throw against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}, you can use your reaction to force a different creature you can see within 120 feet of you to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. If the save fails, the target is {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened} by you (your choice) for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a successful save.

subclassFeature.name: Fey Reinforcements
entries: {@i 11th-level Fey Wanderer feature}

The royal courts of the Feywild have blessed you with the assistance of fey beings: you know {@spell summon fey|tce}. It doesn't count against the number of ranger spells you know, and you can cast it without a material component. You can also cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest.
Whenever you start casting the spell, you can modify it so that it doesn't require {@status concentration}. If you do so, the spell's duration becomes 1 minute for that casting.

subclassFeature.name: Misty Wanderer
entries: {@i 15th-level Fey Wanderer feature}

You can slip in and out of the Feywild to move in a blink of an eye: you can cast {@spell misty step} without expending a spell slot. You can do so a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

In addition, whenever you cast {@i misty step}, you can bring along one willing creature you can see within 5 feet of you. That creature teleports to an unoccupied space of your choice within 5 feet of your destination space.

subclassFeature.name: Swarmkeeper
entries: Feeling a deep connection to the environment around them, some rangers reach out through their magical connection to the world and bond with a swarm of nature spirits. The swarm becomes a potent force in battle, as well as helpful company for the ranger. Some Swarmkeepers are outcasts or hermits, keeping to themselves and their attendant swarms rather than dealing with the discomfort of others. Other Swarmkeepers enjoy building vibrant communities that work for the mutual benefit of all those they consider part of their swarm.

subclassFeature.name: Gathered Swarm
entries: {@i 3rd-level Swarmkeeper feature}

A swarm of intangible nature spirits has bonded itself to you and can assist you in battle. While you're alive, the swarm remains in your space, crawling on you or flying and skittering around you within your space. You determine its appearance, or you generate its appearance by rolling on the Swarm Appearance table.
Once on each of your turns, you can cause the swarm to assist you in one of the following ways, immediately after you hit a creature with an attack:

items: The attack's target takes {@damage 1d6} piercing damage from the swarm.
The attack's target must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC or be moved by the swarm up to 15 feet horizontally in a direction of your choice.
You are moved by the swarm 5 feet horizontally in a direction of your choice.

entries.name: It's Your Swarm
entries: A Swarmkeeper's swarm and spells are reflections of the character's bond with nature spirits. Take the opportunity to describe the swarm and the ranger's magic in play. For example, when your ranger casts gaseous form, they might appear to melt into the swarm, instead of a cloud of mist, or the {@spell arcane eye} spell could create an extension of your swarm that spies for you. Such descriptions don't change the effects of spells, but they are an exciting opportunity to explore your character's narrative through their class abilities. For more guidance on customizing spells, see the "Personalizing Spells" section in chapter 3.

Also, remember that the swarm's appearance is yours to customize, and don't feel confined to a single appearance. Perhaps the spirits' look changes with the ranger's mood or with the seasons. You decide!

subclassFeature.name: Swarmkeeper Magic
entries: {@i 3rd-level Swarmkeeper feature}
You learn the {@spell mage hand} cantrip if you don't already know it. When you cast it, the hand takes the form of your swarming nature spirits.

You also learn an additional spell of 1st level or higher when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Swarmkeeper Spells table. Each spell counts as a ranger spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of ranger spells you know.

subclassFeature.name: Writhing Tide
entries: {@i 7th-level Swarmkeeper feature}

You can condense part of your swarm into a focused mass that lifts you up. As a bonus action, you gain a flying speed of 10 feet and can hover. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you are {@condition incapacitated}.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Mighty Swarm
entries: {@i 11th-level Swarmkeeper feature}
Your Gathered Swarm grows mightier in the following ways:

items: The damage of Gathered Swarm increases to {@damage 1d8}.
If a creature fails its saving throw against being moved by Gathered Swarm, you can also cause the swarm to knock the creature {@condition prone}.
When you are moved by Gathered Swarm, it gives you {@quickref Cover||3||half cover} until the start of your next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Swarming Dispersal
entries: {@i 15th-level Swarmkeeper feature}

You can discorporate into your swarm, avoiding danger. When you take damage, you can use your reaction to give yourself resistance to that damage. You vanish into your swarm and then teleport to an unoccupied space that you can see within 30 feet of you, where you reappear with the swarm.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Gloom Stalker
entries: 幽域追蹤者居身於那些最黑暗的場所：地表深處、暗巷之間、太古叢林、和其他任何籠罩在昏暗微光的地方。大部分人們在進入這種場所時都會驚恐不安，但幽域追蹤者們卻能大膽於黑暗中冒險，試圖在威脅來到廣闊世界之前伏擊它們。這類遊俠經常出沒於幽暗地域，但是他們也會前往任何邪惡勢力蟄伏的所在。

subclassFeature.name: Dread Ambusher
entries: 在3級時，你精通於伏擊的藝術。你可以讓你先攻檢定獲得等同於你睿知調整值的加值。
在每個戰鬥的你的第一個回合開始時，你的步行速度增加10呎，持續直到該回合結束。若你在該回合採取{@action Attack||攻擊}動作，做為該動作的一部份，你可以進行一次額外的武器攻擊。若該攻擊命中，則目標將受到額外{@dice 1d8}該武器傷害類型的傷害。

subclassFeature.name: Gloom Stalker Magic
entries: 從3級開始，當你在本職業升至特定等級，你將學會額外的法術，如幽域追蹤者法術表所示。這些法術對你而言視作遊俠法術，但並不會計入你已知遊俠法術的數量中。

subclassFeature.name: Umbral Sight
entries: 在3級時，你獲得60呎範圍的黑暗視覺。若你已經擁有來自你種族的黑暗視覺，則它的範圍將增加30呎。
你也擅長於避開依賴於黑暗視覺的生物。當處於黑暗環境時，你對任何嘗試依靠黑暗視覺以看見黑暗中的你的生物而言處於{@condition Invisible||隱形}狀態。

subclassFeature.name: Iron Mind
entries: 從7級起，你已磨練出用於抵抗來自於你獵物的精神影響力量的能力。你獲得睿知豁免的熟練。若你已經擁有此熟練，則你可以改為獲得智力豁免或魅力豁免的熟練（由你選擇）。

subclassFeature.name: Stalker's Flurry
entries: 在11級時，你學會以出人意料的高速進行攻擊，以讓你將一次失手轉變成另一次打擊。在你的每個回合一次，當你的一次武器攻擊失手時，你可以進行另一次武器攻擊以做為同個動作的一部份。

subclassFeature.name: Shadowy Dodge
entries: 從15級開始，隨著一縷環繞在你身邊的超自然陰影，你能夠以令人無法預料的方式閃躲。當一個生物對你進行一次攻擊檢定且該檢定不具有優勢，你可以使用你的反應以讓它承受劣勢。你必須在你知道該攻擊檢定的結果之前決定是否使用此能力。

subclassFeature.name: Horizon Walker
entries: 境界行者守護著世界不受來自其他位面、或試圖以異界魔法摧毀凡界的威脅所侵害。他們尋找並看守著位面傳送門，為了追捕他們的敵人而冒險穿梭於內層位面和外層位面。這些遊俠也是多元宇宙中任何致力於守護位面中生靈和秩序的勢力的盟友—尤其是那些善良龍族、精類、和元素生物。

subclassFeature.name: Detect Portal
entries: 在3級時，你獲得以魔法感知位面傳送門存在的能力。以一個動作，你偵測出距離你1哩內最近的位面傳送門的距離以及方位。
一旦你使用此能力，直到你完成一次短休或長休之前你都不能再使用它。
參見《地下城主指南》第二章的「位面旅行」章節以查看關於位面傳送門的例子。

subclassFeature.name: Horizon Walker Magic
entries: 從3級開始，當你在本職業升至特定等級，你將學會額外的法術，如境界行者法術表所示。這些法術對你而言視作遊俠法術，但並不會計入你已知遊俠法術的數量中。

entries.caption: 境界行者法術
rows: {@spell Protection from Evil and Good||防護善惡}

subclassFeature.name: Planar Warrior
entries: 在3級時，你學會汲取多元宇宙中的能量以增強你的攻擊。
以一個附贈動作，選擇一個距離你30呎內且你所能看見的生物。下一次你在該回合以一次武器攻擊命中該生物時，該攻擊所造成的所有傷害都將變成力場傷害，且該生物將受到來自該攻擊的額外{@dice 1d8}力場傷害。當你在本職業升至11級時，這個額外傷害將增加至{@dice 2d8}。

subclassFeature.name: Ethereal Step
entries: 在7級時，你學會跨入乙太位面。以一個附贈動作，你能夠以此能力施放{@spell Etherealness||跨入乙太界}法術，無須消耗法術位。但此法術將在當回合結束時結束。
一旦你使用此能力，直到你完成一次短休或長休之前你都不能再使用它。

subclassFeature.name: Distant Strike
entries: 在11級時，你獲得在眨眼間穿梭於位面間的能力。當你採取{@action Attack||攻擊}動作時，你可以在每次攻擊之前傳送最多10呎距離到一處你所能看見的未被佔據空間。
若你以該動作攻擊了至少二個不同的生物，你可以再額外對第三個生物進行一次攻擊。

subclassFeature.name: Spectral Defense
entries: 在15級時，你穿梭在位面之間的能力讓你得以溜進位面邊界以減輕你在戰鬥中所受到的傷害。當你受到來自於一次攻擊的傷害時，你可以使用你的反應以讓你自己獲得所有對這回合該攻擊傷害的抗性。

subclassFeature.name: Monster Slayer
entries: 你致力於獵殺那些黑夜中的怪物和邪惡魔法的施行者。一名怪物殺手尋覓著吸血鬼、龍、邪惡精類、邪魔、以及其他魔法威脅。受過用以戰勝這類怪物的超自然技術訓練，怪物殺手精通於找出並擊敗那些強大且神秘的敵人。

subclassFeature.name: Hunter's Sense
entries: 在3級時，你獲得凝視一個生物並以魔法知悉傷害它最佳的方式的能力。以一個動作，選擇一個距離你60呎內且你所能看見的生物。你將立刻知道該生物是否擁有任何傷害免疫、抗性、或是易傷，以及它們的種類。若該生物不受預言系魔法影響，則你感知到的結果將會是它不具有任何傷害免疫、抗性、和易傷。
你可以使用此能力的次數等同於你的睿知調整值（最少一次）。你在完成一次長休後恢復所有你花費掉的次數。

subclassFeature.name: Monster Slayer Magic
entries: 從3級開始，當你在本職業升至特定等級，你將學會額外的法術，如怪物殺手法術表所示。這些法術對你而言視作遊俠法術，但並不會計入你已知遊俠法術的數量中。

entries.caption: 怪物殺手法術
rows: {@spell Protection from Evil and Good||防護善惡}

subclassFeature.name: Slayer's Prey
entries: 從3級開始，你可以專注你的憤怒於單一敵人，增加你對它所造成的傷害。以一個附贈動作，你指定一個距離你60呎內且你所能看見的生物做為此能力的目標。每個回合當你第一次以武器攻擊命中目標時，它將額外受到來自該武器的{@dice 1d6}傷害。
這個好處將持續直到你完成一次短休或長休，或在你指定另一個不同生物做為目標時提早結束。

subclassFeature.name: Supernatural Defense
entries: 在7級時，你獲得額外的韌性以抵抗你獵物對你身體和精神所做出的侵襲。每當你殺手獵物所指定的目標強迫你進行一次豁免檢定，或每當你進行一次屬性檢定以嘗試脫離該目標的擒抱，骰{@dice 1d6}並將其加入你的擲骰結果中。

subclassFeature.name: Magic-User's Nemesis
entries: 在11級時，你獲得阻撓其他人魔法的能力。當你看見一個距離你60呎內的生物施放法術或傳送，你可以使用你的反應以嘗試以魔法挫敗它。該生物必須成功通過一次對抗你法術豁免DC的睿知豁免，否則它的法術或傳送將失敗並被浪費。
一旦你使用此能力，直到你完成一次短休或長休之前你都不能再使用它。

subclassFeature.name: Slayer's Counter
entries: 在15級時，你獲得在你的獵物嘗試妨害你時展開反擊的能力。若你殺手獵物所指定的目標強迫你進行一次豁免檢定，你可以使用你的反應以對該獵物進行一次武器攻擊。你在進行該豁免檢定之前立刻進行此攻擊。若你的攻擊命中，則除了該攻擊原本的效果之外，你的豁免檢定也將自動成功。

subclassFeature.name: Frigid Explorer
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Biting Cold
entries: Damage from your weapon attacks, Ranger spells, and Ranger features ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold damage.

entries.name: Frost Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold damage.

entries.name: Polar Strikes
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon, you can deal an extra {@damage 1d4} Cold damage to the target, which can take this extra damage only once per turn. When you reach Ranger level 11, this extra damage increases to {@dice 1d6}.

subclassFeature.name: Hunter's Rime
entries: Ice rimes you and your prey, protecting you and slowing them. When you cast {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB}, you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d10} plus your {@class Ranger|XPHB} level.
Additionally, while a creature is marked by your {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB}, it can't take the {@action Disengage|XPHB} action.

subclassFeature.name: Winter Walker
entries: {@i Withstand the Horrors of Frigid Wastelands}

Winter Walkers hone their craft in the bleak and frozen wilds of places like Icewind Dale. These ruthless, rimed Rangers hunt monsters that haunt arctic wastelands, eventually becoming frigid terrors themselves. Winter Walkers are well versed in the phenomena of Icewind Dale, including the latent magic of fallen Netherese cities, endemic monsters like {@creature yeti|XMM|yetis} and {@creature crag cat|SKT|crag cats}, and the rising threat of Underdark invaders. Due to their cold pragmatism, terrifying magic, and mastery of the region, Winter Walkers are regarded with equal parts respect and fear. Ten-Towns citizens say that Winter Walkers' frequent exposure to malignant entities gives them their fearsome powers. Many Reghed nomads, on the other hand, believe that nature spirits bestow on Winter Walkers a unique curse.

subclassFeature.name: Winter Walker Spells
entries: When you reach a Ranger level specified in the Winter Walker Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

subclassFeature.name: Fortifying Soul
entries: Your experience surviving harrowing environments allows you to bolster your allies in addition to yourself. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, choose a number of creatures you can see equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one). Each chosen creature regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d10} plus your Ranger level and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 hour.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Chilling Retribution
entries: When a creature hits you with an attack roll, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to force the creature to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn. While the target is {@condition Stunned|XPHB}, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced to 0 feet.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Frozen Haunt
entries: When you cast {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB}, you can adopt a ghostly, snowy form. This form lasts until the spell ends, and while you are in this form, you gain the following benefits. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} unless you expend a level 4+ spell slot (no action required).

entries.name: Frozen Soul
entries: You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Cold damage. When you first adopt this form and at the start of each of your subsequent turns, each creature of your choice in a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you takes {@damage 2d4} Cold damage.

entries.name: Partially Incorporeal
entries: You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Prone|XPHB}, and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions. You can move through creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}, but you take {@damage 1d10} Force damage if you end your turn inside a creature or an object. If the form ends while you are inside a creature or an object, you are shunted to the nearest unoccupied space.

subclassFeature.name: Beast Master
entries: {@i Bond with a Primal Beast}
獸王與一隻特殊的動物締結神秘的羈絆，汲取原初魔法以及與自然世界的深厚連結。

subclassFeature.name: Primal Companion
entries: 你以魔法召喚一隻原初野獸，牠從你與自然的羈絆中汲取力量。選擇牠的數據：{@creature Beast of the Land|XPHB}、{@creature Beast of the Sea|XPHB}或{@creature Beast of the Sky|XPHB}。你也決定牠是哪一種動物，選擇一種適合該數據的種類。無論你選擇哪種野獸，牠身上都帶有原初紋路，顯示牠的超自然起源。
野獸對你與你的盟友友善，並服從你的命令。若你死亡，牠便會消失。

entries.name: The Beast in Combat
entries: 在戰鬥中，野獸在你的回合中行動。牠可以自行移動並使用牠的{@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|反應}，但除非你採取一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}命令牠採取其數據中的動作或其他動作，否則牠唯一會採取的動作是{@action Dodge|XPHB|閃避}動作。當你採取{@action Attack|XPHB|攻擊}動作時，你也可以犧牲其中一次攻擊，命令野獸採取「野獸打擊」動作。若你陷入{@condition Incapacitated|XPHB|無力}狀態，野獸會自行行動，且不限於{@action Dodge|XPHB|閃避}動作。

entries.name: Restoring or Replacing the Beast
entries: 若野獸在過去一小時內死亡，你可以採取一個{@action Magic|XPHB|魔法}動作觸碰牠並消耗一個法術欄位。野獸會在 1 分鐘後復活，並恢復所有{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}。
每當你完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}，你可以召喚另一隻原初野獸，牠會出現在你周圍 5 呎內的一個未佔據空間。你選擇牠的數據與外觀。若你已擁有一隻來自此能力的野獸，舊的野獸會在新的出現時消失。

subclassFeature.name: Exceptional Training
entries: 當你採取一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}命令你的原初夥伴野獸採取一個動作時，你也可以命令牠使用牠的{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}採取{@action Dash|XPHB|疾走}、{@action Disengage|XPHB|撤離}、{@action Dodge|XPHB|閃避}或{@action Help|XPHB|協助}動作。
此外，每當牠以攻擊檢定命中並造成傷害時，牠可以造成力場傷害或其原本的傷害類型，由你選擇。

subclassFeature.name: Bestial Fury
entries: 當你命令你的原初夥伴野獸採取「野獸打擊」動作時，野獸可以使用它兩次。
此外，野獸每回合第一次命中一個受你{@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB|獵人印記}法術影響的生物時，額外造成等同該法術額外傷害的力場傷害。

subclassFeature.name: Share Spells
entries: 當你施展一個以你自己為目標的法術時，若你的原初夥伴野獸位於你周圍 30 呎內，你也可以讓該法術影響牠。

subclassFeature.name: Fey Wanderer
entries: {@i Wield Fey Mirth and Fury}
由於大妖精的恩賜，或是妖精荒野中某個改變了你的地方，一股妖精的神秘氣息圍繞著你。無論你如何獲得妖精魔法，你如今都是一名妖精漫遊者。你歡快的笑聲點亮受壓迫者的心，而你的武藝讓敵人膽寒，因為妖精的歡笑何其盛大，他們的怒火就何其可怕。

subclassFeature.name: Dreadful Strikes
entries: 你能以汲取自妖精荒野幽暗谷地、足以在心靈上留下創傷的魔法，強化你的武器打擊。當你以武器命中一個生物時，你可以對目標額外造成 {@damage 1d4} 點精神傷害，目標每回合只會受到一次此額外傷害。當你達到遊俠 11 級時，額外傷害提升為 {@damage 1d6}。

subclassFeature.name: Fey Wanderer Spells
entries: 當你達到妖精漫遊者法術表中指定的遊俠等級時，你從此總是準備著表中所列的法術。
你也擁有一份妖精的祝福。從妖精荒野贈禮表中選擇或隨機決定。

entries.caption: 妖精荒野贈禮
rows: 當你進行{@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|短休}或{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時，幻象蝴蝶在你周圍翩翩飛舞。
每天黎明時，花朵會從你的頭髮中綻放。
你身上隱約散發著肉桂、薰衣草、肉荳蔻或其他令人安心的香草或香料氣味。
當沒有人直視你的影子時，它會跳舞。
你的頭上長出了角或鹿角。
你的皮膚與頭髮每天黎明時都會變色。

subclassFeature.name: Otherworldly Glamour
entries: 每當你進行魅力檢定時，你在該檢定上獲得等同你睿知調整值的加值（最少 +1）。
你也從以下技能中選擇一項並獲得熟練：{@skill Deception|XPHB|欺瞞}、{@skill Performance|XPHB|表演}或{@skill Persuasion|XPHB|說服}。

subclassFeature.name: Beguiling Twist
entries: 妖精荒野的魔法守護你的心智。你在為了避免或結束{@condition Charmed|XPHB|魅惑}或{@condition Frightened|XPHB|恐懼}狀態而進行的豁免檢定上具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。

此外，每當你或你周圍 120 呎內一個你能看見的生物，在為了避免或結束{@condition Charmed|XPHB|魅惑}或{@condition Frightened|XPHB|恐懼}狀態的豁免檢定中成功時，你可以採取一個{@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|反應}，迫使你周圍 120 呎內另一個你能看見的生物對你的法術豁免 DC 進行一次睿知豁免。豁免失敗時，目標陷入{@condition Charmed|XPHB|魅惑}或{@condition Frightened|XPHB|恐懼}狀態（由你選擇）1 分鐘。目標在它的每個回合結束時重複這次豁免，成功則結束其自身受到的效果。

subclassFeature.name: Fey Reinforcements
entries: 你可以不使用材料構材施展{@spell Summon Fey|XPHB|召喚精類}。你也可以不使用法術欄位施展它一次，並在完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時恢復以此方式施展它的能力。
每當你開始施展此法術時，你可以調整它，使其不需要{@status Concentration|XPHB|專注}。若你這麼做，該次施法的持續時間變為 1 分鐘。

subclassFeature.name: Misty Wanderer
entries: 你可以不消耗法術欄位施展{@spell Misty Step|XPHB|迷蹤步}。你能這麼做的次數等同於你的睿知調整值（最少一次），並在完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時恢復所有已消耗的使用次數。
此外，每當你施展{@spell Misty Step|XPHB|迷蹤步}時，你可以帶上你周圍 5 呎內一個你能看見的自願生物。該生物傳送到你目的地空間周圍 5 呎內一個由你選擇的未佔據空間。

subclassFeature.name: Dread Ambusher
entries: 你已精通設下駭人埋伏的技藝，獲得以下益處。

entries.name: Ambusher's Leap
entries: 在每場戰鬥你的第一個回合開始時，你的{@variantrule Speed|XPHB|速度}增加 10 呎，直到該回合結束為止。

entries.name: Dreadful Strike
entries: 當你以武器攻擊並命中一個生物時，你可以額外造成 {@damage 2d6} 點精神傷害。此益處每回合只能使用一次，你可以使用它的次數等同於你的睿知調整值（最少一次），並在完成一次{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}時恢復所有已消耗的使用次數。

entries.name: Initiative Bonus
entries: 當你擲{@variantrule Initiative|XPHB|先攻}時，你可以將你的睿知調整值加到擲骰上。

subclassFeature.name: Gloom Stalker
entries: {@i Draw on Shadow Magic to Fight Your Foes}
幽域追蹤者在最黑暗的地方如魚得水，運用汲取自幽影界的魔法，對抗潛伏於黑暗中的敵人。

subclassFeature.name: Gloom Stalker Spells
entries: 當你達到幽域追蹤者法術表中指定的遊俠等級時，你從此總是準備著表中所列的法術。

subclassFeature.name: Umbral Sight
entries: 你獲得範圍 60 呎的{@sense Darkvision|XPHB|黑暗視覺}。若你獲得此能力時已擁有{@sense Darkvision|XPHB|黑暗視覺}，其範圍增加 60 呎。
你也擅長躲避依賴{@sense Darkvision|XPHB|黑暗視覺}的生物。當你完全處於{@variantrule Darkness|XPHB|黑暗}中時，對任何依賴{@sense Darkvision|XPHB|黑暗視覺}在該{@variantrule Darkness|XPHB|黑暗}中看見你的生物而言，你處於{@condition Invisible|XPHB|隱形}狀態。

subclassFeature.name: Iron Mind
entries: 你已磨練出抵抗改變心智之力的能力。你獲得睿知豁免檢定熟練。若你已擁有此熟練，你改為獲得智力或魅力豁免檢定熟練（由你選擇）。

subclassFeature.name: Stalker's Flurry
entries: 你駭人打擊的精神傷害變為 {@damage 2d8}。此外，當你使用懼怖伏兵能力的駭人打擊效果時，你可以造成下列其中一種額外效果。

entries.name: Sudden Strike
entries: 你可以用同一把武器對另一個生物再進行一次攻擊，該生物必須位於原目標周圍 5 呎內且在武器射程內。

entries.name: Mass Fear
entries: 目標以及它周圍 10 呎內的每個生物，都必須對你的法術豁免 DC 進行一次睿知豁免檢定。豁免失敗的生物陷入{@condition Frightened|XPHB|恐懼}狀態，直到你的下個回合開始為止。

subclassFeature.name: Shadowy Dodge
entries: 當一個生物對你進行攻擊檢定時，你可以採取一個{@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|反應}使該次擲骰具有{@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB|劣勢}。無論攻擊命中或落空，你接著都可以傳送至多 30 呎，到達一個你能看見的未佔據空間。

subclassFeature.name: Hunter
entries: {@i Protect Nature and People from Destruction}
你在荒野與其他地方追獵獵物，運用你身為獵人的能力，保護自然與各地的人們免受意圖毀滅他們的力量所害。

subclassFeature.name: Hunter's Lore
entries: 你可以呼喚自然之力，揭露你獵物的特定強項與弱點。當一個生物被你的獵人印記標記時，你得知該生物是否具有任何免疫、抗性或易傷，若有，你也得知它們是什麼。

subclassFeature.name: Hunter's Prey
entries: 你獲得下列其中一個由你選擇的能力選項。每當你完成一次{@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|短休}或{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}，你可以將所選選項替換為另一個。

entries.name: Colossus Slayer
entries: 你的堅韌足以磨垮最頑強的敵人。當你以武器命中一個生物時，若它已損失任何{@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|生命值}，該武器對目標額外造成 {@damage 1d8} 點傷害。你每回合只能造成一次此額外傷害。

entries.name: Horde Breaker
entries: 在你的每個回合中限一次，當你以武器進行攻擊時，你可以用同一把武器對另一個生物再進行一次攻擊，該生物必須位於原目標周圍 5 呎內、在武器射程內，且你本回合尚未攻擊過它。

subclassFeature.name: Defensive Tactics
entries: 你獲得下列其中一個由你選擇的能力選項。每當你完成一次{@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|短休}或{@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|長休}，你可以將所選選項替換為另一個。

entries.name: Escape the Horde
entries: 針對你的{@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|藉機攻擊}具有{@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB|劣勢}。

entries.name: Multiattack Defense
entries: 當一個生物以攻擊檢定命中你時，該生物本回合對你進行的所有其他攻擊檢定具有{@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB|劣勢}。

subclassFeature.name: Superior Hunter's Prey
entries: 每回合一次，當你對一個被你的獵人印記標記的生物造成傷害時，你也可以對第一個生物周圍 30 呎內另一個你能看見的生物，造成該法術的額外傷害。

subclassFeature.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
entries: 當你受到傷害時，你可以採取一個{@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|反應}，使自己對該傷害以及任何相同類型的其他傷害具有{@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|抗性}，直到當前回合結束為止。
